attribution: Team project. Existing homepage identifies Wenrui Xu as a Dream Classroom Volunteer. No individual design responsibility asserted.
school_location_note: Homepage names a primary school while the supplied article also mentions Lhatse County Middle School. The website caption uses county-level location without resolving the institution.

files.title: Lhatse Dream Classroom — Completed Interior
files.description:
Lhatse, Shigatse, Tibet, China.
Completed in 2021. The renovated classroom brings reading, teaching, independent study, and group discussion into one shared space. Stepped bookshelves, flexible tables, and a landscape mural connect the room’s activities and spatial identity.
files.source: DOCX word/media/image2.jpeg; paragraph 7 follows the spatial-design description and precedes the completion account.

files.title: Before Renovation — Existing Space and School Requirements
files.description:
Lhatse, Shigatse, Tibet, China.
Page 4 of the original proposal records the existing classroom and the school’s requirements. The approximately 67 m² room was to accommodate independent study, lessons, reading, and discussion.
